Provide quality support of Expression Platforms team members through data acquisition, reporting, and communication. Execute in vitro analytical assays to evaluate samples with minimal supervision. Accountable for performing all techniques and assays so test sessions yield valid results and repeated work is minimized. Accurately record all data from research techniques and tests on data capture forms, research notebooks, and raw data notebooks as appropriate. Perform initial data analysis so that accurate and precise results are obtained and reported. Generate documentation (ex. Method protocols, reports) in support of techniques or modification of techniques. Ability to learn new types of assays and technology easily.
cond_0093.requirements:

Bachelor's degree in a relevant scientific discipline from an accredited institution, or equivalent practical experience.
Biotechnology Laboratory Methods certification combined with an Associate's degree and relevant job experience is also considered.
Some background in performing multiple types of assays (biochemical, molecular, and immunological).
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with assay development, mammalian cell culture, ELISA, Western blotting, and qPCR.
Exposure to standard molecular biology techniques such as cloning, protein expression, and purification.

Work alongside Expression Platforms team members to support data acquisition, reporting, and communication.
Coordinate with the team to initiate, execute, and complete research activities, sharing results and related issues as they arise.
Execute in vitro analytical assays to evaluate samples with minimal supervision.
Help ensure all techniques and assays yield valid results and that repeated work is minimized.
Accurately record all data from research techniques and tests on data capture forms, research notebooks, and raw data notebooks as appropriate.
Perform initial data analysis so that accurate and precise results are obtained and reported to the team.
Contribute to documentation (e.g., method protocols, reports) in support of techniques or modification of techniques.
Learn new types of assays and technology as needed to support team goals.
cond_0378.requirements:
BS degree from an accredited institution in a relevant scientific discipline; or Biotechnology Laboratory Methods certification in combination with an AS degree and relevant job experience.
Able to competently perform multiple types of assays (biochemical, molecular, and immunological in nature).
Experience in assay development, mammalian cell culture, ELISA, Western blotting, qPCR, and experience in standard molecular biology techniques such as cloning, protein expression and purification is preferred.
